package: Relintor P6 Independent Audit Repair Gate
created_for: Independent audit of P6 Standards + Requirement Graph + Sealing
findings: P6-IA-01 P4/P5 project requirements are not imported into the sealed graph
P6-IA-02 missing facts silently become N/A
P6-IA-03 applicable critical rules can disappear with matching task cleanup
P6-IA-04 applicability ledger can be forged without deterministic pre-seal recomputation
P6-IA-05 non-waivable critical rules can be deferred
P6-IA-06 task coverage links are not cross-checked with task requirement ownership
P6-IA-07 registry digest is order-sensitive through pack digests
P6-IA-08 seal manifest/identity metadata is not fully cryptographically bound
P6-IA-09 persistence primary keys lose stable IDs across missions/revisions
P6-IA-10 persistence/load do not enforce seal integrity
P6-IA-11 desktop Seal & Build/trusted production registry path is not wired
P6-IA-12 per-requirement sealed_hash is never populated
